en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Before I left the academy...
I decided to talk alone with Gonta.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the last day we'll spend
at this academy...

<CLT=cltMIND>This school life was crazy, but now that
I think back on it, we had some good times.

Feels like time flew by.
Maybe cuz Shuichi is here?

Gonta has so much fun talking to Shuichi.
Time always fly by so fast.
I also had a lot of fun thanks to you, Gonta.

If you weren't around, I wouldn't
have been so active and energized.

Hey, Gonta. What are you going to
do when you leave?

Gonta will keep moving forward!
Forward to Gonta's goal!

As long as Gonta tries hard, Gonta
can reach any goal!

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta's goal...
What was it again?
Capture all the bugs in the world
Become like the wind
Reconcile both his families

You wanted to capture all the bugs
in the world, right, Gonta?

True, Gonta would love to meet
every insect in the world...
But that's not Gonta's number one goal.

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
Gonta's goal must be...
To race like the wind?

That would be amazing, but...Gonta
doesn't really wanna do that.

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
Gonta's goal must be...

You want your real family to accept
your forest family, right?

Yeah! For that, Gonta's gonna work hard
as <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Forest family is reason why Gonta was
able to become <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

If Gonta keeps being <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
maybe real family will accept forest family!

I know they'll accept them, Gonta.
Your talent is truly amazing!

After we get out of here, I want to
help you with anything you need.
Shuichi helps Gonta all the time.
Gonta is really glad he met Shuichi.
If Gonta never met Shuichi...

Gonta wouldn't know how to get
forest family accepted...

To Gonta, Shuichi is truest gentleman
there is!

<CLT=cltMIND>I firmly grasped the hand
that was held out to me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta's hand was much bigger
than I anticipated...

<CLT=cltMIND>These hands...can reach
any goal they want to.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure that he will get
his families to reconcile.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can say that with conviction.
I am Gonta's best friend, after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, our days at the
Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles...
<CLT=cltMIND>came to an end.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme,
"Love Across the Universe."
